name: Fuyu no Otogibanashi
source:
This is an 18 and above Japanese style animal-boys love Windows adventure game for women. 

Having lost his memory and lost in a blizzard, the main character arrives in a mystical mountain village. A village where beasts have the ability to transform into people and talk using human language. This is where he must spend his winter...

There are 110 pages of CG, and that doesn't even include the extras. There are over 25 endings. Depending on the choices you make, the main character can end up an uke or a seme at the end. A time attack element is also in play.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036193.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款面向女性、仅限18岁以上玩家的日式兽人男男恋爱Windows冒险游戏。

主角失去记忆，在暴风雪中迷路，最终抵达一座神秘的山村。村里的兽人能够变成人形，并使用人类语言交谈。他必须在这里度过这个冬天……

游戏包含110页CG，这还不包括额外内容。结局超过25种。根据你的选择，主角最终可能成为受方，也可能成为攻方。游戏还加入了限时挑战要素。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036193.html]DLsite English[/url]]
